article.title: YouCam Muse推出歌曲與音樂影片製作，支援逐場修改分鏡
article.summary: Perfect Corp.推出YouCam Muse，讓創作者把歌曲構思或音軌轉成音樂影片，現供網頁及iOS使用。
highlights: 使用者可先審閱AI分鏡，再調整場景或重新生成鏡頭。
平台提供唱歌、敘事及混合視覺模式，並支援1080p輸出。
article.why: 音樂導向的短片企劃可先在分鏡階段比較歌曲與畫面配合，決定哪些段落需要重新構圖或演繹。
article.next_step: 用同一段歌曲副歌建立兩種視覺模式，先比較場景與歌詞的配合，再只重生需要修改的鏡頭。
article.detail: 公告表示，YouCam Muse可從自己的歌詞生成歌曲，也可使用上載音軌。網頁及iOS共用帳戶和點數，影片生成使用Seedance 2.5。團隊可以把AI分鏡作為前期討論材料，逐場記錄需要調整的角色、畫面及節奏，再比較修改後是否更貼近歌曲要表達的內容。
article.title_en: YouCam Muse adds songs and music videos with editable storyboards
article.summary_en: Perfect Corp. launched YouCam Muse on web and iOS to turn song ideas or audio tracks into music videos.
highlights_en: Users can review an AI storyboard, adjust scenes and regenerate individual shots.
Singing, storytelling and hybrid visual modes support 1080p export.
article.why_en: Music-led creative teams can compare how lyrics and scenes work together before deciding which shots need revision.
article.next_step_en: Use one chorus in two visual modes and regenerate only the shots that miss its meaning.
article.detail_en: The release describes lyric-to-song generation and uploaded tracks, with shared accounts and credits across web and iOS. Videos use Seedance 2.5. Treat the storyboard as pre-production material and record character, scene and timing revisions against the song's intended message.
